limitations: The combined solar factor groups preliminary electrical losses and design margin; it is not supplier performance data.
The battery factor is a combined preliminary sizing factor; cell chemistry, depth of discharge, aging and thermal limits remain unselected.
Active-PV equivalent area excludes packing, gaps, structure, mechanisms, harness and pointing losses, so it is not gross array planform.
Radiator area is an idealized effective-area screen. View factors, sink temperature, coatings, orientation, degradation and two-sided geometry are not modeled.
All results are pre-SRR screening values and require supplier data, coupled analysis and test validation.
